gloss: soon; in the near future; shortly

definitions.gloss: soon; in the near future; shortly; coming soon
definitions.explanation: Refers to an upcoming date or time in the near future. Often used in announcements and notices.

examples.japanese: {近日|きんじつ}{公開|こうかい}{予定|よてい}。
{近日|きんじつ}{中|ちゅう}にお{返事|へんじ}いたします。
examples.english: I will reply within the next few days.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}は{近日|きんじつ}{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}となりますので、もうしばらくお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: The new product will go on sale shortly, so please wait a little longer.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal word commonly seen in advertisements, movie trailers, and business communications. {近日|きんじつ}{中|ちゅう} (within the coming days) is a very common form that specifies a slightly more concrete timeframe.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近日|きんじつ}{公開|こうかい} (coming soon — for movies, websites)
- {近日|きんじつ}{発売|はつばい} (on sale soon)
- {近日|きんじつ}{中|ちゅう} (within the next few days)
- {近日|きんじつ}{中|ちゅう}に (shortly, soon)
